name: EPIC 220476316
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 7.8 solar radii and 0.76 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 4,107 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.76 solar masses and 7.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,009 K at its surface.
